title: Grand Façade
summary: Grand Façade is a defensive, blue-skinned Meso-Titan. His strong armor is impregnable, and long hair covers his one weak spot on his back. In contrast to his tribal-style armor, he wears a futuristic, red visor on his face. Grand Façade is used by Mr. Wilder as his secret weapon.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Grand Façade was invoked by Mr. Wilder in Hernán Cortés' vault to fight against Dante Vale's Caliban for the Ring of Umbra, the Legendary Titan of Dimensions. After a big fight, Grand Façade was defeated when Dante trapped his legs using Stopglue, allowing Caliban to find and stab Grand Façade's unarmored back. [The Power of Umbra]

Grand Façade again was invoked by Mr. Wilder in the Professor's castle in a fight for Rassimov's secret files. After throwing Cherit against a wall, he attempted to attack Den Fears before being hit by Cherit's energy blast. He then tried to asphyxiate Grier who responded by invoking Powerbonded Breaker. Grand Façade was then defeated when Breaker used his Crushing Grip power on him. [An Ally from the Organization]

Mr. Wilder later invoked Grand Façade in Yonaguni, whilst fighting the Huntik team for the Amulet of Kyojin. Lok tried to attack him with the Willblade but Grand Façade deflected the attack, redirecting it at Sophie and Den, rendering them unconscious. He then joined Myrmidon in fighting Powerbonded Pendragon. When Lok managed to retrieve the Amulet, he summoned Kyojin, causing a huge whirlpool, knocking everyone backwards and sending Grand Façade and the Organization underwater. [The Guardian of Yonaguni]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext: Grand Façade is almost entirely covered in invulnerable armor, the exception being on his back. This armor is powerful enough to completely negate the attacks of powerful Titans on the tier of [[Caliban]]. Due to this armor, Grand Façade is able to wear out his opponents and then finish them off with ease. As Grand Façade possesses no weapons, he instead fights using his fists and strength for combat. His red visor can fire beams of light that can deflect incoming energy attacks including energy from the [[Willblade]]. {{source|The Guardian of Yonaguni}}

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
*Grand Façade's summoning command is "Show them."
*The name "Grand Façade" uses the English variant spelling of the word "facade," making him the only Titan whose official English name is spelt with an accent (a cedilla), as seen in Huntik Magazine. [HM18] 
**Due to localized captioning guidelines that often ommit accents on letters, Netflix subtitles spell Grand Façade's name without the cedilla as Grand Facade.

Grand Façade is a defensive, blue-skinned Meso-Titan. His strong armor is impregnable, and long hair covers his one weak spot on his back. In contrast to his tribal-style armor, he wears a futuristic, red visor on his face. Grand Façade is used by Mr. Wilder as his secret weapon.

After throwing Cherit against a wall, he attempted to attack Den Fears before being hit by Cherit's energy blast. He then tried to asphyxiate Grier who responded by invoking Powerbonded Breaker. Grand Façade was then defeated when Breaker used his Crushing Grip power on him. [An Ally from the Organization]

Mr. Wilder later invoked Grand Façade in Yonaguni, whilst fighting the Huntik team for the Amulet of Kyojin. Lok tried to attack him with the Willblade but Grand Façade deflected the attack, redirecting it at Sophie and Den, rendering them unconscious. [The Guardian of Yonaguni]

==Abilities==
Grand Façade is almost entirely covered in invulnerable armor, the exception being on his back. This armor is powerful enough to completely negate the attacks of powerful Titans on the tier of Caliban. Due to this armor, Grand Façade is able to wear out his opponents and then finish them off with ease. As Grand Façade possesses no weapons, he instead fights using his fists and strength for combat. His red visor can fire beams of light that can deflect incoming energy attacks including energy from the Willblade. [The Guardian of Yonaguni]
